info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Agents-v1-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API provides a comprehensive means for consumers to access detailed information about property listings associated with specific real estate agents. It allows users to retrieve a curated list of properties showcasing key details such as location, price, and agent contact information. This API is essential for real estate platforms, analysts, and potential buyers seeking to evaluate market offerings through the expertise of agents. By leveraging this functionality, users can make informed decisions in their property search.

get.summary: Retrieve listings managed by a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all real estate listings that are currently assigned to a particular agent. This can be useful for viewing an agent's active properties and managing their portfolio efficiently.
